zh-CN.name: Desk-Deck 快捷控制台
zh-CN.description: 六个大按钮，四套桌面场景。USB 连接 Windows，轻点发送快捷键，翻转切换页面。开发预览版：按键固定，网页配置尚未接入。

en.name: Desk-Deck
en.description: Six large keys, four desktop profiles. Connect to Windows over USB. Tap to send shortcuts; rotate to switch pages. Developer preview with fixed keys; no live web configuration.
